text: In 2023 Icelandic Glacial's shareholders sold a substantial stake in the business to a new investor group investing through Liechtenstein-based holding company Iceland Star Property Ltd., which became the new incoming majority shareholder; the Icelandic founders and Blackrock-managed funds remained significant shareholders.
short: Iceland Star Property Ltd. became Icelandic Water Holdings' incoming majority shareholder in 2023
